name: Slack BSAR
description: Creates a Slack channel for every SAR CoreEvent placed on a CoreEvent Board or created in a TAK Server Channel.

permissions.description: Reads the current links of a CoreEvent so the Slack channel link is appended instead of replacing them
Adds the URL of the created Slack channel to the links of the CoreEvent

types.description: Creates a Slack channel when a SAR CoreEvent is created in the configured Channel (Channel Event trigger), unarchiving it if it already exists
Creates a Slack channel when a SAR CoreEvent is first placed on the configured Board (Board Placement trigger), unarchiving it if it already exists
Unarchives the Slack channel of a SAR CoreEvent when it is moved on the configured Board (Board Placement trigger) and ensures the channel is linked from the CoreEvent
Archives the Slack channel of a SAR CoreEvent when it is removed from the configured Board (Board Placement trigger)

Rewrites the pinned message of the Slack channel of a SAR CoreEvent with its current details and mirrors its Links as bookmarks of that channel - opening the channel if the CoreEvent qualifies for the trigger but has none, and unarchiving it in Channel mode
Archives the Slack channel of a SAR CoreEvent when the CoreEvent is deleted
